title: Which country does the most good for the world? | Simon Anholt
summary: Policy advisor Simon Anholt presents the Good Country Index, a measure of how much each nation contributes to the world beyond its own borders. In a funny TED talk he argues governments should think globally, and reveals which countries rank surprisingly.
why: HN points to it as an alternative to GDP for measuring national progress and as background on the Good Country Index.

quote.text: Maybe this is a better way of measuring progress instead of GDP and productivity?
